# openmetadata_dashboard Data Source

Looks up a single OpenMetadata dashboard by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_dashboard" "revenue" {
  fully_qualified_name = "analytics_dashboards.revenue"
}

output "revenue_dashboard_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_dashboard.revenue.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Dashboard fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Dashboard UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `charts` (List of String) Chart fully qualified names.
- `dashboard_type` (String) Kind of dashboard, for example Dashboard or Report.
- `data_models` (List of String) Dashboard data model fully qualified names.
- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `name` (String) Dashboard name.
- `service` (String) Fully qualified name of the dashboard service that owns the dashboard.
- `source_url` (String) URL of the dashboard in the source system.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
